newsitem.title: NIGERIA: Heineken ups stake in Nigerian Breweries.
newsitem.headline: Heineken ups stake in Nigerian Breweries.

text.p: Dutch brewer Heineken has raised its holdings in Nigerian Breweries Plc to 28 percent from 13.4 percent, the Nigerian company said on Monday.
This followed the divestment of Britain's Unilever from the Nigerian firm leaving the shares which were taken up by Heineken, it said in a statement.
"Consistent with coporate polices of Unilever and Heineken to focus on their core businesses, Heineken has secured the shares of Unilever in Nigerian Breweries Plc," it said.
It said the acquisition would help Nigerian Breweries "enjoy the benefit of the latest technology and expertise in brewing."
Nigerian Breweries, the oldest and biggest in the country, brews beers, stout and non-alcoholic malts in five locations in the country.
Last month, it announced a marginal increase in half year profit to 642.3 million naira for the period to end-June 1996 from 554 million naira for the same year-ago period.
